quartz.rationale: The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals and no registered required goals or deliverables to fail. Numbered condition 1 instead derives obligations from the signed order: optional G4 cannot satisfy mandatory R8, and R3 and R5 are unrepresented.

maple.rationale: The registered required goals have current passing receipts and usable outputs, so the legacy adapter passes. Numbered condition 1 uses the signed-order domain, not merely the registry: mandatory R3 lacks a required goal, criterion, and accepted usable checklist.

orchid.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R5 with R6, and all current mandatory items have accepted usable outputs and passing required criteria. X16 addresses another order and does not bar publication.

linen.rationale: All required outputs and criteria pass, so the registry-local legacy adapter passes. However, S81 became durable before publication. Numbered condition 6 and the final-transition authority guard suppress a new success notification despite the earlier passing assessment.
